findings.text: the recorded baseline_suite and after_suite both run tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, which imports only reckon.interface_counts and neither reckon.crew.station_subscriber nor reckon.crew.session_host, so the done_when's clause that the tests importing the changed modules add no failure against the base revision was never measured and the recorded added_failure_count of 0 is evidence about a file the change does not reach.

delivered_run_owes_review has no caller left at dea3224b0c (git grep finds only its definition and a docstring reference), so the change leaves a dead public function whose behaviour the new rule supersedes.

the docstring claims the pane and the obligations view cannot disagree, but terminal_run_duty_items omits the reviews_in_flight and _refused_delivered_review exclusions that _obligations_view applies at reckon/crew/obligations.py:2996-3005, so a scoring run whose review run ended without storing a review keeps the pane while the coordinator's view lists no duty for it.

the assertion that the pane and the obligations view agree compares terminal_run_duty_items output against the same pointer run_id it was called with, rather than reading the obligations view, so it cannot detect the disagreement it names and would stay true if the two readers diverged.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 86493937b5; the single commit dea3224b0c adds terminal_run_duty_items and run_owes_its_coordinator to reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py, swaps the predicate at live_work_populations, and adds the test and the evidence fragment, with no path outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_run_owing_its_coordinator_keeps_the_pane.py and the negative control; that file is recorded green (after-arm.log, 8 passed, EXIT=0) and negative-control.log shows 4 failed, but the done_when's clause that the tests importing station_subscriber or session_host add no failure against the base revision was not run over those files.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a run owing its coordinator an action keeps the pane; reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:337 makes the has-live-work rule read every terminal run's own duties, and the five keep-live cases in the added test exercise promotion owed, promotable, refused landing, owed repair and needs-help.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 8 passed / EXIT=0 for the new test, the negative-control log, the two changed code paths and an outside_scope note about the obligations.py per-row loop, but its baseline_suite and after_suite fields name a test file that does not import the changed modules.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py and tests/test_a_run_owing_its_coordinator_keeps_the_pane.py plus the granted evidence fragment and figures directory; git diff --stat 86493937b5..dea3224b0c shows exactly those three files changed.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows 4 of 5 keep-live cases failing when the review-only rule is restored, so the keep-live assertions do redden on the regression they guard; the one independent-assertion gap is at tests/test_a_run_owing_its_coordinator_keeps_the_pane.py:223.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_run_owing_its_coordinator_keeps_the_pane.py is recorded green at after-arm.log (8 passed, EXIT=0) with a genuine negative control, but the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite (manifest.md:17-18) run tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, which imports only reckon.interface_counts, so the done_when's no-added-failure clause is unmeasured.
justifications.fit: the new functions at reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:170 and :220 follow the surrounding module's idiom (local obligations import, Any-typed now, optional live_pointers/placements) and introduce no plan label, ticket id or attribution, though the superseded delivered_run_owes_review at :91 is left in place.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:337 gates live_work_populations on run_owes_its_coordinator, so a terminal run with any duty carrying its own run_id keeps the session live rather than only a run owing its review.
justifications.reuse: terminal_run_duty_items at reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:170 re-implements the per-row duty dispatch that reckon/crew/obligations.py:2979-3049 already owns in _obligations_view, calling that module's helpers but duplicating its branch selection rather than extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff of 86493937b5..dea3224b0c touches only reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py, tests/test_a_run_owing_its_coordinator_keeps_the_pane.py and the granted evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/, all inside the declared and granted paths.
